parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle or knob of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to open or close the water flow by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or lifts to regulate the water flow through the faucet.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of brass, connecting the spout and switch to the water supply.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and provides structural support for the faucet assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet tube of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water from the faucet body to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may swivel in some designs to adjust water direction.
